ordered_stages.actions: Record bike/build, fluids and fault; oil drain as appropriate, cool; body/fuel access and negative-then-positive isolation.

Use inlined engine-interface access through supported throttle body and labeled coolant hoses. For truly bare frame, detach full throttle/control and radiator assemblies rather than retaining them attached; those additional closures remain open.
Execute engine access and removal portion, pause for bench job. Engine/arm support must be coordinated before shared pivot withdraw.
Remove wheel/chain and free closed brake assembly, linkage, swingarm. Composite must avoid duplicate pivot withdrawal after engine removal.
Remove wheel/fork/bar/clamps/bearing stack. Supported handlebar remains attached in standalone operation; complete controls/harness detachment is required before bare frame.

Remove rear-frame assembly, electrical holders/harness, radiators, footrest brackets and remaining frame attachments; photo-map every holder and tie. This stage is not yet an approved instruction sequence.
Record structural damage findings; no invented frame alignment tolerance or welding/straightening method. Exact frame repair acceptance remains outside current evidence.

Rebuild attachment/routing layers and coordinated engine/pivot/swingarm, then front-end, wheel/brake/chain, intake/exhaust/fuel/cooling/electrical closure. Restore from source-specific operations; do not blindly reverse a generic list.

Mounts, bearings, controls, hydraulics, wiring lock-to-lock, chain at prescribed reference, cooling leaks, oil flow/level and separately verified engine timing/internal work. No ride-ready inference from checked phase count.

Full rear-frame assembly removal/refit, four38Nm bolts, upper-chain-tensioner new pin orientation, holder/ECU/CCU/battery routing closure.
Exact mounting damper/collar stacks and each hose/pipe newseal decision,137.3kPa leak check if this assembly removed.
Every frame harness/holder release and ordered restoration; preserve tape/color/tie direction and connector covers.
Complete bracket/pin/spring inventory and assembly sequence, not just55Nm bracket table.
Source-reviewed composite sequence preventing duplicated/missing work at engine/swingarm common pivot, plus separate completion ledger for tasks omitted by intact variants.
